schema: version 1. structures[]: id, name, status (approved|candidate|retired), sources[] {brand, days, adLibraryUrl, image relative to this dir}, layout (agents/ad-concepts/structures.js LAYOUTS), ratio (the structure's default run ratio, 1:1|4:5) and optional ratios[] (every run ratio it supports, each one its layout renders; a run uses ONE output ratio, default 4:5, and only selects structures supporting it), fits[] product kinds (ordered: the run puts a structure on the --products entry whose kind comes first here), requires[] evidence (review|offer|catalogFact|bundleLanding), people (none|hands|face), scene {primary, fallback} for the product plate with placeholders {productNoun} and {productDescriptionShort}, optional plates[] ordered {kind: product|generic, productFree: bool, ratio (the plate's own render ratio: 1:1|4:5|3:4|9:16), scene {primary, fallback}} for multi-plate layouts (a generic plate is unbranded and product-free), slots, optional rows (fixed generic rows), notes. labelled-bundle structures carry labelPositions[]: 2-4 of {x, y, tx, ty}, 0-1 frame fractions (label centre, product point), applied to the labels in order. Phone-shot look and the no-text and label-ink blocks are added by code, not written here.

structures.name: Customer comment card + offer band

scene.primary: Our {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) sits on a light wood bathroom counter, lid off and leaning against it where it has one, the product visible; it is in the lower third of the frame, label facing the camera. The upper half of the frame is a plain, softly out-of-focus pale wall.
scene.fallback: Our {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) stands upright and large on a plain light surface, centred in the lower two thirds of the frame, label facing straight at the camera, sharp and evenly lit. The upper third is a plain, softly out-of-focus pale wall.

headline.style: a 2-4 word category title in the reviewer's own framing

structures.notes: A real review as a social-comment card over the product, with a plain band. Do not invent names, avatars as people, or likes counts; attribute "Customer review".

structures.name: Finger-scoop texture close-up

scene.primary: Extreme close-up: one hand holds our open {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) from below while the index finger of the other hand lifts a generous, glossy swirl of thick white product out of it. The label is visible below the rim. Very shallow depth of field, soft warm window light, a blurred neutral background with clean empty space in the upper-left third of the frame. Natural relaxed hands with five fingers each, short unpainted nails.
scene.fallback: Close-up of our {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) standing large in the lower half of the frame, label facing the camera, with one finger resting beside a small dab of the product on the surface. Soft warm window light, blurred neutral background, clean empty space in the upper-left third.

headline.style: a short texture benefit built only from words in a chosen review (soft, not greasy), no claim beyond it

structures.notes: Texture is the hook; the headline is sourced from review wording. Hands trigger human review. Do not copy the competitor body-part imagery.

structures.name: What they think we sell / what we actually sell

scene.primary: Our {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) stands upright on a white marble bathroom counter, centred and large: it fills about 65% of the frame height, label facing straight at the camera, sharp and evenly lit. Behind it, softly out of focus, a bright airy bathroom with a green plant.
scene.fallback: Our {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) stands upright and very large on a plain light surface, filling about 75% of the frame height, label facing the camera, evenly lit, plain softly blurred background.

scene.primary: A plain, unbranded clear plastic tub of solid white cooking coconut oil, lid off, a metal spoon stuck in it, sitting on a cluttered kitchen counter next to a frying pan. Unlabelled: no logo, no printing, no text on the tub.
scene.fallback: A plain, unbranded jar of solid white cooking fat, lid off, on a kitchen counter. Unlabelled: no logo, no printing, no text anywhere.

structures.notes: The left plate is a generic product-free kitchen-staple stand-in (never a competitor brand); the right is our verified product. Do not copy the competitor humour or any claim about their product.

structures.name: Ours vs theirs checklist

scene.primary: Our {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) stands upright on a plain light surface in the right half of the frame, large, label facing the camera, evenly lit; the left half is plain, softly blurred and empty.
scene.fallback: Our {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) stands upright and very large, centred on a plain light surface, label facing the camera, evenly lit, plain softly blurred background.

structures.notes: Our facts only, each stated verbatim in the catalog or PDP; theirs is a generic category, never a brand. The fixed theirs rows are category negatives and must still clear the claim gates.

structures.name: Plain product group shot

scene.primary: Our {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) stands on a plain light wooden surface, large and centred, label facing the camera, soft daylight, a plain softly blurred neutral background.
scene.fallback: Our {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) stands upright and very large on a plain light surface, filling most of the frame height, label facing the camera, evenly lit, plain background.

structures.notes: No overlay text except an optional band. The longest-running survivor is the plainest.

structures.name: Labelled bundle with offer

scene.primary: Our bundle products ({productDescriptionShort}) are arranged together on a plain light surface, standing upright and large with labels facing the camera, evenly lit, plain softly blurred background, clear empty space along the bottom.
scene.fallback: Our {productNoun} ({productDescriptionShort}) stands upright and large, centred on a plain light surface, label facing the camera, evenly lit, clear empty space along the bottom.

structures.notes: Only runs when --offer is verified and the landing product is a bundle. Offer text is the verified price pair only.
